summary: Phase 4 implementation complete. Delivered typed core domain contracts, sensor-semantic band resolution across optical and SAR platforms, deterministic spectral and spatial measurement tools, bi-temporal change analytics, SAR flood mapping, learned Change-VQA specialist baseline, and 100% passing test suite.

deterministic_capabilities.area_measurement: Planar determinant area calculation for projected CRSs; geodesic surface element integration on WGS84 ellipsoid for angular geographic CRSs; pixel counting excluding NoData; conversions across m2, ha, km2.
deterministic_capabilities.spectral_indices: Normalized difference calculation for NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, NDWI_GAO, NDBI, NBR with zero-division protection, physical range clamping [-1, 1], and ROI pixel bounds clipping.
deterministic_capabilities.mask_generation: Deterministic threshold masking with explicit physical policies (vegetation dense >= 0.50, moderate >= 0.30; water NDWI/MNDWI > 0.0; built-up NDBI > 0.0; burn severity NBR < -0.1).

temporal_capabilities.pair_validation: Strict validation of pre/post observation pairs enforcing chronological ordering (t1 < t2), spatial footprint overlap fraction, CRS transformability, and grid co-registration alignment.
temporal_capabilities.vegetation_change: Bi-temporal NDVI differencing to compute vegetation loss and gain, baseline area, percent change, and physical area quantification.
temporal_capabilities.water_change: Bi-temporal NDWI/MNDWI differencing for surface water appearance (flood) and disappearance (drought) mapping.

sar_capabilities.backscatter_analytics: Linear amplitude to decibel (dB) conversion, decibel differencing, and dual-polarization (VV, VH, HH, HV) handling.
sar_capabilities.flood_mapping: Deterministic SAR flood inundation mapping based on pre-to-post backscatter decrease (>= 3.0 dB drop) combined with post-event water threshold (<= -16.0 dB in VV).

learned_change_specialist.selection_rationale: SmolVLM-256M natively supports multi-image inputs ([Image 1, Image 2, Text Prompt]), enabling direct bi-temporal change reasoning without requiring complex architectural redesign. Complements deterministic GIS evidence.

P4-E01.name: Deterministic spectral and area measurement validation
P4-E01.description: Validated spectral index math, zero-division protection, ROI clipping, planar/geodesic area measurement, and bi-temporal vegetation change on synthetic/geospatial fixtures.

P4-E02.name: Bi-temporal Change-VQA learned specialist baseline evaluation
P4-E02.description: Evaluated SmolVLM multi-image Change-VQA specialist baseline on CDVQA/LEVIR-CC change fixtures.

P4-E03.name: Parameter-efficient adaptation
P4-E03.description: Frozen SmolVLM multi-image VLM baseline achieves required performance without immediate fine-tuning.

P4-E04.name: SAR temporal backscatter and flood change validation
P4-E04.description: Validated linear-to-dB conversion, backscatter delta computation, SAR flood inundation mapping, and temporal pair verification.

frozen_decisions: R-GEO-004 / R-GEO-005: Metric area calculation uses affine determinant for projected CRSs and geodesic integration on WGS84 ellipsoid for geographic CRSs. Angular degrees are never treated as linear meters.

R-VERIFY-001 - R-VERIFY-006: Independent verification checks (CRS validity, spatial overlap, grid alignment, physical range, temporal order, provenance) gate model execution. Verification status FAIL halts ungrounded language output.
Sensor-Semantic Band Resolution: Algorithms request semantic roles (RED, GREEN, NIR, SWIR, SAR_CO_POL, SAR_CROSS_POL) rather than hardcoded band indices.
Bi-temporal change requires two temporally ordered observations (t1 < t2). Single image change requests return REQUEST_INPUT.
